note: Admission rationale per final CQ: what independent evidence landscape does this question own? (contract section 15; stored here, NOT added to CQS schema)

admission_rationales.CQ-01: Owns the evidence landscape of paradigm-level work claims inside the Virtual Cell field (what candidate paradigms the literature itself generates).
